registration.primary_plan: Kenoyer 1991 Fig. 4.2 (p. 31) & Kenoyer 2008 Fig. 3 (p. 28), HARP metric grid

properties.name: Mound F (Great Granary and Workmen's Quarters walled sector)
properties.source_citation: Kenoyer 1991 Fig. 4.2 (p. 31); Kenoyer 2008 Fig. 3 (p. 28); Wheeler 1947 Pl. XV
properties.notes: Conserved Mature Harappan granary, circular working platforms and workmen's quarters.

properties.name: Mound AB (Citadel defences and high mound)
properties.source_citation: Wheeler 1947 Pl. XV; Kenoyer 1991 Fig. 4.2 (p. 31); Kenoyer 2008 Fig. 3 (p. 28)
properties.notes: Fortified mud-brick perimeter wall, Vats and Wheeler excavations, HARP Operation 2.

properties.name: Mound E (Urban sector, kilns and southern gateway)
properties.source_citation: Kenoyer 1991 Fig. 4.2 (p. 31); Kenoyer 2008 Fig. 3 (p. 28)
properties.notes: HARP Operation 3 kilns, revetment wall, Early-to-Mature perimeter wall #30 and gateway #84.

properties.name: Mound ET (Eastern walled suburb and Old Police Station)
properties.source_citation: Kenoyer 2008 Fig. 3 (p. 28); Kenoyer 1991 Fig. 4.2 (p. 31)
properties.notes: Walled eastern suburb with southern gateway linking to Mound E.

properties.name: Northeastern Walled Sector beneath Modern Harappa Town
properties.source_citation: Kenoyer 1991 p. 57 ('approximately one quarter of the total area of the site'); Kenoyer 2008 Fig. 3 (p. 28, shaded sector '? = Walls not excavated')
properties.notes: Shaded walled sector in Kenoyer 2008 Fig. 3 directly beneath modern Harappa town; perimeter walls unexcavated.

properties.name: Low Western Mound
properties.source_citation: Kenoyer 1991 Fig. 4.2 (p. 31); Kenoyer 2008 Fig. 3 (p. 28)
properties.notes: Lower western occupation rise tested by HARP test pits.

properties.name: Cemetery H and Cemetery R37 mortuary zone
properties.source_citation: Wheeler 1947 Pl. XV; Kenoyer 1991 Fig. 4.2 (p. 31, HARP Operation 1)
properties.notes: Mature Harappan Cemetery R37 and Late Harappan Cemetery H south of Mound AB.

properties.name: Area G / Vats southeastern archaeological zone
properties.source_citation: Kenoyer 2008 Fig. 3 (p. 28, labeled 'Vats'); Vats 1940
properties.notes: Southern scatter and Vats excavation area south of the Chichawatni-Sahiwal road.

properties.name: Central Inter-Mound Clearing (West Edge of Harappa Town)
properties.source_basis: Esri z16/z18, ESA WorldCover 2021, Kenoyer 2008 Fig. 3 ('?' wall edge)
properties.notes: Broad treeless bare-earth clearing straddling the inferred western perimeter wall of the concealed town sector between Mound AB and modern Harappa town.

properties.name: South Town to Mound E/ET Transition Clearing
properties.source_basis: Esri z16/z18, ESA WorldCover 2021, Kenoyer 2008 Fig. 3
properties.notes: Open unbuilt strip between the southern margin of modern Harappa town and the northern perimeter of Mounds E and ET.

properties.name: Low Western Mound Open Terrace
properties.source_basis: Esri z18, ESA WorldCover 2021, Kenoyer 1991 Fig. 4.2
properties.notes: Open bare/scrub western mound margin suitable for continuous GPR and magnetometry grids.

properties.name: Cemetery H to Mound AB South Open Ground
properties.source_basis: Esri z18, ESA WorldCover 2021, Wheeler 1947 Pl. XV
properties.notes: Open grassy/bare ground south of Mound AB rampart wall; non-invasive mapping of Late Harappan and post-Harappan deposits.

properties.name: Northwest Town Edge Dry Terrace (East of Mound F)
properties.notes: Open agricultural/bare apron between Mound F eastern edge and the modern town pond.

properties.name: Harappa Town Northwest Pond / Depression Basin
properties.source_basis: Esri z16/z18 (green standing pond), ESA WorldCover 2021, Copernicus GLO-30
properties.notes: Algae-covered pond/basin at NW edge of modern Harappa town; WorldCover 2021 misclassifies eutrophic algae as vegetation (water=0.0) while Copernicus DEM confirms a -0.56 m local depression.

properties.name: Mound AB Muslim Tomb & Protected Citadel Core (Heritage Control)
properties.notes: Active religious shrine (Muslim tomb) and protected tree-covered citadel core; Rule D5 heritage/sacred exclusion control.

properties.name: Harappa Town West & South Perimeter Street Rescue Corridor
properties.source_basis: Esri z16/z18, OpenStreetMap Harappa streets, Kenoyer 2008 Fig. 3
properties.notes: Public street and utility corridor tracing the western and southern flanks of modern Harappa town across the concealed NE walled sector.

properties.name: Chichawatni-Sahiwal Road Archaeological Frontage Corridor
properties.source_basis: Esri z16/z18, OpenStreetMap Harappa Road, Kenoyer 1991 Fig. 4.2
properties.notes: Regional highway corridor bordering Cemetery R37, Harappa Museum, Mound E southern gateway, Mound ET and Area G.

properties.name: Eastern Harappa Town Open Sports / Vacant Margin
properties.notes: Open unbuilt ground east of modern Harappa town testing whether the buried NE urban sector extends beyond E2700.
